description: This file defines a Flutter ChangeNotifier controller called AppSearchController for managing search functionality in the app. It handles query updates, search execution via a repository, caching recent searches, and notifies listeners about state changes.

classes.name: AppSearchController
classes.description: A controller class for managing search state and logic in a Flutter app, including handling user queries, executing searches, caching recent searches, and notifying UI components of state changes.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the current search query and notifies listeners.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Performs a search with the current query, updates recent searches cache, and updates results and loading state.
